story.fullStory:
Chris Brown's "Forever" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Forever" is a song by American singer Chris Brown.

Brown co-wrote the song with Andre Merritt, Rob Allen, Brian Kennedy, and Jamal "Polow da Don" Jones; the latter two are also the producers.

Initially created to be used for a Doublemint commercial, "Forever" was selected to be released as the lead single from the reissue version of Brown's second studio album Exclusive, titled the Forever Edition, and the fifth single overall from the album.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 33 weeks on the chart.
